title: abandoned_cart.completed
description:
This schema provides a detailed representation of an abandoned cart. 
An abandoned cart is a shopping cart where items have been added but the 
purchase has not been finalized. The cart is considered abandoned 
after **10 minutes** of inactivity. This schema outlines all the 
relevant information about the cart, the customer, and the products involved.

id.description: Unique identifier for the abandoned cart.

url.description: URL to access the abandoned cart and continue the checkout process. This is crucial for re-engaging customers.

products_count.description: Number of products in the abandoned cart.

products.description: List of products in the abandoned cart.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product. (Set to null if is_external_product is true)

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit - unique identifier that allows a product to be tracked for inventory purposes.

price.description: The base price of the item, represented as a floating-point number. This value does not include any additional charges or discounts.

formatted_sale_price.description: The number of units of the item being purchased or included in the order.

images.description: This array stores information about the product images.

id.description: A unique identifier for the image, typically represented as a UUID (Universally Unique Identifier).

origin.description: The URL of the original image or its default thumbnail.

fullSize.description: The URL of the full-sized, high-resolution version of the image.

thumbnail.description: The URL of a small-sized thumbnail image, optimized for use in compact display spaces such as galleries or lists.

small.description: The URL of a slightly larger version of the image compared to thumbnail, suitable for small-sized displays or previews.

medium.description: The URL of a medium-sized image, ideal for standard display spaces or when more detail is needed without the full resolution.

large.description: The URL of a large-sized version of the image, useful for bigger displays or when a higher level of detail is required.

thumbs.description: An object containing different resolutions of the image for various use cases. Each key within this object represents a specific size or type of image thumbnail.

custom_field.description: A list of custom attributes or metadata associated with the item.

price_string.description: The base price of the item, formatted as a string with currency (e.g., "SAR"). This representation is typically used for display purposes.

additions_price.description: The total price of any optional additions or extras added to the item. This value is represented as a floating-point number.

additions_price_string.description: The total price of additions, formatted as a string with currency. Used for display purposes to show the cost of extras in a user-friendly format.

total.description: The total cost for the item.

total_string.description: The total cost for the item, formatted as a string with currency.

history.description: History of actions related to the abandoned cart.

uuid.description: Unique identifier for the history entry.

abandoned_cart_id.description: Identifier linking to the abandoned cart.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the action was performed.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the action was last updated.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the cart was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the cart was last updated.

phase.description:
Current phase of the abandoned cart. This indicates the last step the customer reached before abandoning the cart.
The phases are as follows:
- `completed`: The cart has been converted into an order.
- `shipping_address`: The customer has provided a shipping address.
- `verification`: The customer is in the verification process.
- `shipping_method`: The customer has chosen a shipping method.
- `new`: The cart has been recently created but no further action has been taken.
- `login`: The customer is prompted to log in or register.
- `payment-method`: The customer has selected a payment method but has not completed the purchase.

customer_id.description: A unique identifier for the customer.

customer_name.description: The full name of the customer.

customer_email.description: The email address of the customer.

reminders_count.description: The number of reminders sent to the customer regarding the transaction or payment.

cart_total.description: The total cost of items in the cart, represented as a floating-point number.

cart_total_string.description: The total cost of items in the cart, formatted as a string with the currency (e.g., "SAR").

source.description:
Indicating the source or channel of the order. This can be one of several predefined values:
- **catalog**: Order was made through a product catalog or online storefront.
- **mobile_app**: Order was made through the store's mobile application.

message.description: Message related to the request status.

priority.description: Priority of the city. Higher number indicates higher priority.

country_id.description: Unique identifier of the country the city is located in

country_name.description: Name of the country the city is located in (in Arabic)

country_code.description: Two-letter country code according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

ar_name.description: Name of the city in Arabic

en_name.description: Name of the city in English
